findings.description: The chunk delivered to this voice rendered zero diff lines. The truncation notice lists tests/unit/adversarial-review-companion.bats as the only file and marks it omitted under the 24000-token budget, so the companion suite (40 cases per the implementation report) received no dissent review from this voice on this chunk. No code finding can be made or refuted from an empty diff.
findings.failure_mode: The run records a completed two-voice dissent for this chunk while one voice examined nothing. The companion suite is exactly where the eighth run found ten inert `! cmd` assertions, so a regression of that class in the round-1m changes would pass unexamined, and the verdict-quality envelope for this chunk overstates coverage.
findings.suggested_fix: Have the chunk driver treat a chunk whose rendered diff is empty after truncation as a dispatch error instead of sending it. For this file, split the suite diff into two byte-balanced hunk halves the way the driver already splits the script diff (a1/a2), or raise the per-chunk budget for test-only chunks, and re-run this chunk on the current commit.
